summary: Replace the overly restrictive UI guardrail with a Replace-Not-Overlay architecture: explicit standard/full-bleed route surfaces, route-owned page CSS with anti-shell-hiding enforcement, and cleanup of the temporary Customers CSS workaround without changing CRM business ownership or APIs.
protectedReason: The owner explicitly requested correction of the global UI protection itself so pages can be genuinely replaced instead of layered. This requires a central AppShell route-surface contract and architecture guard changes; the protection is being strengthened against overlays rather than bypassed.
